text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 231 tablets (19.9 days), Corvale General holds 262 tablets (19 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 98 tablets (26.9 days). The drug carries an FDA status of "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product is marked "To Be Discontinued" but do not list it on the current shortage list. The rule‑based check notes FDA actions and weak links but no action before a posting at a registered plant, so the buyer should verify current supplier status.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 19–27 days of supply across sites. No active shortage exists, but the discontinuation status warrants proactive sourcing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify Accord Healthcare Inc. supply availability and plant registration; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if verified.
2. Buyer to verify Actavis Pharma, Inc. supply availability and plant registration; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if verified.
3. Buyer to verify Aurobindo Pharma Limited supply availability and plant registration; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if verified.
4. Buyer to verify Chartwell RX, LLC supply availability and plant registration; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if verified.
5. Buyer to verify Coupler LLC supply availability and plant registration; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if verified.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
